source_excerpt: Direct damages are capped at fees paid in the prior 12 months, excluding confidentiality breach, willful misconduct, and injunctive relief.
target_excerpt: All damages are capped at one month of fees, including confidentiality breach and equitable remedies.
expected_review_focus: The cap narrows recovery and newly applies to confidentiality breach and equitable remedies.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review may recommend negotiation, but the final risk decision remains with the reviewer.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review flags the lowered cap and inclusion of confidentiality breach or equitable remedies.

source_excerpt: Confidentiality obligations continue for three years after disclosure.
target_excerpt: Confidentiality obligations continue for five years after disclosure.
expected_review_focus: The confidentiality survival period is extended and may increase operational burden.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should describe the change and ask for reviewer confirmation instead of finalizing acceptance.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review catches the term extension and frames it as a business/legal review point.

source_excerpt: Confidential Information excludes information independently developed without use of Confidential Information.
target_excerpt: The independently developed exclusion is removed.
expected_review_focus: Removing the independent-development exclusion broadens protected information.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should not create a new exclusion; it can suggest restoring or negotiating the clause.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review identifies the removed carveout as the central issue.

source_excerpt: Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days written notice.
target_excerpt: Recipient may terminate for convenience with 10 days written notice.
expected_review_focus: The notice period is shortened and termination right is no longer mutual.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should keep the deterministic compare item as the source of the changed text.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review mentions both shorter notice and unilateral termination.

source_excerpt: Customer has 10 business days to reject non-conforming deliverables with written reasons.
target_excerpt: Deliverables are deemed accepted after 3 business days unless Customer provides detailed defect evidence.
expected_review_focus: The acceptance window is shortened and deemed acceptance becomes easier to trigger.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review may recommend reverting the acceptance window, but cannot mark the item resolved.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review highlights both timing and deemed acceptance risk.

source_excerpt: Fees are invoiced monthly in arrears and payable 30 days after invoice.
target_excerpt: Fifty percent of fees are due upfront and remaining invoices are payable 15 days after invoice.
expected_review_focus: The payment schedule accelerates cash outflow and reduces review time.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should ground the issue in payment timing, not invent unrelated pricing concerns.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review identifies upfront payment or shorter payment period.

source_excerpt: Customer owns all custom deliverables upon full payment.
target_excerpt: Vendor retains ownership of all deliverables and grants Customer a non-exclusive internal-use license.
expected_review_focus: Ownership changes from customer ownership to vendor ownership with a limited license.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should request reviewer/legal confirmation rather than conclude enforceability.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review flags ownership transfer as high risk.

target_excerpt: Vendor may charge time-and-materials fees for out-of-scope requests before written change-order approval.
expected_review_focus: The added clause permits charges before a signed change order.
truth_boundary_assertion: The AI review should not suppress the added-clause compare truth.
scoring_notes: Pass when the review catches pre-approval fee exposure.
